verdict.rationale: Jan's GitHub README lists MCP integration for agentic capabilities, and its desktop docs say it can connect to MCP servers. A dedicated MCP docs page describes inline per-tool-call approval panels that show the arguments, and the changelog ships a first-party Jan Browser MCP. Together this clearly shows it acts as an MCP client that uses server tools. Missing for 10: documentation of how to add or configure arbitrary third-party MCP servers (config format, supported transports), and independent or hands-on corroboration that plugging in servers works.
